caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed ceramic vessel with a rounded, asymmetrical oval opening at the top. The vessel is rendered in shades of blue, gray, and subtle brown tones. The body of the vessel has vertical, elongated, oval-shaped grooves filled with brownish hues and is outlined with blue and gray shading, creating a ribbed texture. The top portion of the vessel has a wide, thick rim with a smooth, curving profile. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details. The artist's signature, "H.A. Imansh," appears in small print near the lower right of the vessel.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
